name: plexus-data-network
description: Plexus data network motion graphic - 4K Remotion compositions (Canvas 2D)

scripts.render:v1: remotion render PlexusNetwork-V1-Reference "out/Version 1 - Plexus Data Network - Reference Match (1080p).mp4" --scale=0.5
scripts.render:v2: remotion render PlexusNetwork-V2-AmberPalette "out/Version 2 - Plexus Data Network - Amber Palette (1080p).mp4" --scale=0.5
scripts.render:all: npm run render:v1 && npm run render:v2
scripts.render:v1:4k: remotion render PlexusNetwork-V1-Reference "out/Version 1 - Plexus Data Network - Reference Match (4K).mp4"
scripts.render:v2:4k: remotion render PlexusNetwork-V2-AmberPalette "out/Version 2 - Plexus Data Network - Amber Palette (4K).mp4"
